Making food into a heap") is a training rule (*sekhiya*) governing monastic dining etiquette found in the Vinaya Piṭaka of the Pali canon. It regulates proper conduct regarding not heaping up food into a mound when receiving or eating alms, and has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
